title: CACE-Bench: A Synthetic Agentic Evaluation Benchmark for LLM Credit-Pipeline Agents
description: Compliance-Aware Credit-agent Evaluation (CACE-Bench): a fully synthetic, reproducible benchmark and generator for evaluating and auto-evolving LLM-agent credit pipelines under auditability constraints. Measures hallucination rate, recovery rate, compliance false-positive rate and step-level correctness.
